name: OpenSSH
caveat: The version comes from the greeting the server sends. Some systems fix a fault without changing that version, so check the vendor's advisory before treating this as certain.

entries.title: regreSSHion: code can be run as root without a login
entries.detail: A timing fault in the SSH server lets an attacker who keeps trying run code as root without logging in. It was shown on Linux systems that use glibc; other systems are thought to be much harder or impossible to exploit.

entries.title: Terrapin: parts of the SSH handshake can be removed in transit
entries.detail: Someone who sits between the client and the server can remove messages at the start of a connection and so weaken it. Both ends need the fix for it to take effect.
